description.en: Code-generated Chinese video skill plugin, proposal-first and zero-template. You keep only a film.json in your project and run the skill scripts in place (no copying). Each brief is sampled into several distinct design candidates (no built-in style packs); the user confirms one and it is frozen into a design DSL. visual.subtitle controls caption style and visual.layout_cycle rotates layouts per chapter, while a cross-film design ledger keeps delivered videos from repeating. An 8-question intake first pins the production mode (code-drawn frames vs. footage-cut vs. hybrid) and recommends one from the topic; code-drawn videos go through proposal-first design while footage-cutting uses the footage contract (no proposal layer). Pipeline: script, measured TTS timeline, cue-driven programmatic SFX and score, deterministic PIL/browser frame rendering (16:9 and 9:16 canvases; portrait needs --layout portrait), ffmpeg encoding, sample-level mixing, and multi-layer QA gates (preflight / full-film VMAF+SSIM / ASR read-back). Hybrid mode never tints footage: matchstyle.py measures the footage (hue/saturation/value + dark-or-light) and re-anchors the code-drawn segments' palette and letterbox to it, so both halves read as one film. Camera moves are jitter-free (endpoint-prebaked blend instead of NEAREST resampling of a grain-baked plate, guarded by self-check #68), and a weak ASR read-back lists the characters that did not line up (lost_top) instead of a bare score. 97 self-check assertions and 15 repo checks are green.
description.zh: 中文视频生成技能插件：提案优先、零模板。工程目录里只需要一个 film.json，技能脚本留在技能目录里直接跑，不用拷贝任何脚本或模板。每个 brief 现场采样出多个互不相同的设计方案（没有内置风格表），用户确认后才冻结成设计 DSL。design 里的 visual.subtitle 控制字幕样式、visual.layout_cycle 按章节轮换版式；片间去重台账记录交付过的设计，让不同片不重复。开场 8 题问诊（含「制作方式」：自己画 / 网上素材剪辑 / 两者结合，按题材给推荐并落地成产线；素材线不走提案层）→ 写剧本 → 实测 TTS 时长排轴 → 提示点驱动配乐与音效 → PIL/浏览器逐帧渲染 → ffmpeg 编码 → 采样级混音 → 多层质检（渲前预检 / 全片 VMAF+SSIM / ASR 回读）。hybrid（素材+图文按段拼）不给素材叠色：matchstyle.py 抽样测出素材的色相/饱和/明暗，再把图文段的配色与遮幅锚到素材上，两段看起来才像一部片。取景不抖（端点预烘 + blend，自检第 68 条守住），ASR 回读掉分时直接列出没对上的字符（lost_top）。画幅支持 16:9 横屏与 9:16 竖屏（竖屏加 --layout portrait，experimental：版式原生、节奏未复核）。自检 97 条、仓库体检 15 项全绿。
